title: 中国哲学（四）：墨子的思想
subtitle: Chinese Philosophy IV · The Thought of Mozi

cards.example: 墨子是中国重要的思想家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi was an important Chinese thinker.

cards.example: 墨子是战国时期的重要思想家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi was an important thinker of the Warring States period.

cards.example: 墨子创立了墨家学派。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi founded the Mohist school.

cards.example: 墨子创立了自己的学派。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi founded his own school of thought.

cards.example: 墨子和他的学生大多是手工业者。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi and most of his students were artisans.

cards.example: 墨子认为每一个人都应该劳动。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi believed everyone should work.

cards.example: 人只有参加劳动才能享受劳动成果。
cards.exampleTranslation: Only by joining in labor can people enjoy its fruits.

cards.back: to possess; to take possession of
cards.example: 不劳动而占有别人的劳动成果是不对的。
cards.exampleTranslation: It is wrong to possess the fruits of others' labor without working.

cards.example: 墨子认为不劳而获是不道德的。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi believed getting something for nothing is immoral.

cards.example: 兼爱就是人与人之间互相爱。
cards.exampleTranslation: Universal love means people loving one another.

cards.example: 墨子认为人的最高道德是爱人。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi believed the highest morality is to love others.

cards.example: 孔子、孟子主张爱有差等。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius and Mencius advocated graded love.

cards.example: 墨子主张爱无差等。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi advocated love without distinctions.

cards.example: 墨子反对爱的差别。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi opposed distinctions in love.

cards.example: 墨子的兼爱就是要人们互相帮助。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi's universal love means people should help one another.

cards.example: 兼爱不只靠嘴上说，还要做到交相利。
cards.exampleTranslation: Universal love is not just talk; it must bring mutual benefit.

cards.example: 有爱心又能帮助别人，才是道德的行为。
cards.exampleTranslation: Actions are moral only when they come from compassion and help others.

cards.back: against aggression; opposition to offensive war
cards.example: 墨子提出了非攻的主张。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi put forward the idea of opposing aggressive war.

cards.example: 战国时期，各国战火不断。
cards.exampleTranslation: During the Warring States period, wars kept breaking out among the states.

cards.example: 墨子看到战争害得百姓受苦。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi saw that war caused suffering among the common people.

cards.example: 战争会让很多人的家园破碎。
cards.exampleTranslation: War can shatter many people's homes.

cards.example: 墨子认为战争是罪恶。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi believed war is evil.

cards.example: 墨子主张要和平，反对战争。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi advocated peace and opposed war.

cards.example: 墨子派弟子到宋国帮助守城。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi sent his disciples to Song to help defend the city.

cards.example: 墨子说服了楚王，不再攻打宋国。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi persuaded the king of Chu not to attack Song again.

cards.example: 墨子名翟。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi's given name was Di.

cards.example: 楚国曾经想攻打宋国。
cards.exampleTranslation: The state of Chu once wanted to attack Song.

cards.example: 墨子帮助宋国守城。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi helped Song defend its city.

cards.example: 墨子亲自到楚国说服楚王。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi personally went to Chu to persuade the king of Chu.

cards.example: 墨子是墨家学派的创始人。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mozi was the founder of the Mohist school.

cards.back: Mozi, the book compiled from his sayings
cards.example: 弟子把墨子的言论编成了《墨子》一书。
cards.exampleTranslation: His disciples compiled Mozi's sayings into the book Mozi.
